0022600009.text: The San Antonio Spurs, now 0-1 after one game and 5th in the Southwest, 0.5 games back and 15th in the West, host the Houston Rockets, who open their 2026-27 season. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026, the most recent meeting between the teams. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery), and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Houston is missing Steven Adams (out, calf soreness).
